request: Build a Jac library that converts a subset of Markdown to HTML: headings, paragraphs, emphasis and strong, inline code, fenced code blocks, links and unordered lists. Raw HTML in the input is escaped. main.jac reads a Markdown file path from the command line and prints the HTML.
acceptance:
'# Title' becomes '

Title

', while seven '#' characters stay a paragraph.
Text inside a fenced code block is not parsed for emphasis and '<' in it becomes '<'.
'**bold *nested* text**' gives correctly nested strong and em tags; an unclosed '**' is kept literally.
constraints: Use Jac 0.36.1. This is a Jac library with a command-line entry in main.jac, not a web app.
No network, no external APIs; the library functions are pure and tested with `jac test`.

source.note: Requirements written in English from the project's feature description; no code or text copied. Only one feature slice is reproduced.

support_files.purpose: Configure Jac 0.36.1 with a [project] section (name, version) and entry-point main.jac.
